description: This file provides utility functions for file and directory operations, including permission checks, directory creation, file zeroing, and file removal, within the etcd project.

methods.name: IsDirWriteable
methods.description: Checks if a directory is writable by attempting to create and remove a temporary file.

methods.name: TouchDirAll
methods.description: Creates directories with 0700 permissions if they do not exist and ensures the directory is writable.

methods.name: CreateDirAll
methods.description: Creates directories and verifies that the deepest directory is empty.

methods.name: Exist
methods.description: Checks if a file or directory exists.

methods.name: DirEmpty
methods.description: Checks if a directory is empty and accessible.

methods.name: ZeroToEnd
methods.description: Zeros out a file from the current position to the end.

methods.name: CheckDirPermission
methods.description: Verifies directory permissions match the expected mode.

methods.name: RemoveMatchFile
methods.description: Removes files in a directory that match a given condition.

methods.name: ListFiles
methods.description: Lists files in a directory that match a given condition.
